reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Separate optical, reporter and target kinetics with substrate titration and proposed independent product validation.

checks.quote: # Distinguishing Target Inhibition, Substrate Competition, and Reporter-System Interference
checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior target/reporter Methods, supplements or a validated protocol before execution and check transfer of detailed conditions.

checks.quote: at minimum, inner-filter artifact is present
checks.reason: Fluorophore loss without enzyme is not specific for inner-filter absorption; chemical product loss or other quenching can cause it.
Spectra/solubility/activity qualification do not establish reagent identity/purity and authenticated compound stock concentration.
Buffer/pH/cofactors/temperature and reaction preparation remain unspecified without a concrete setting/calibration procedure.
No primary product amount/concentration and time unit convention and complete weak/missing quantitative reporting rule.
Independent days and wells are distinguished, but the fixed replicate counts lack a variance/precision/effect-size justification.
Pooled kinetic fits lack independent-day/nested uncertainty handling and free-inhibitor/depletion assumptions; Cheng-Prusoff applicability is not checked.

Reporter-only fluorescence loss is called enzyme inhibition without explicitly correcting that arm for optical attenuation (correction is assigned to Arm C). The central reporter measurement cannot identify catalytic loss on that basis.
Bounded series and gates are present but no lock of pilot-selected settings/windows/model choice before independent confirmation.
No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after reformulation/repair.
Unchanged direct product is treated as exclusion of target inhibition without an equivalence/precision rule; reduced product needs substrate/product chemical alternatives excluded.
Matrix-processed standards help but no operational compound-dependent recovery/ion suppression/product stability validation establishes independent target chemistry accuracy.
No raw-file/unit identifiers, source provenance and exact code/software/settings audit.
Active vehicle, omissions, product/fluorophore controls and reporter bypass are prospectively distinguished; conditional known inhibitors are not assumed available.
Addresses main evidence, soluble-window/aggregation alternatives and kinetic comparison; specific optical/reporter attribution failures are charged only in G1/P09/P13.
